findings.note: Both teams come into Week 7 at 2-4, and the Eagles lost starting QB Jalen Hurts to injured reserve with deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary emboli, so he will likely miss the rest of the season.

The Eagles ruled out WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, plus OLB Nolan Smith and DB Michael Carter II, which leaves QB Tanner McKee relying on rookie Makai Lemon, though Barkley practiced fully, is listed questionable and Goedert is good to go.
Dallas ruled out WR/returner KaVontae Turpin, LB Dee Winters and OT Drew Shelton, and downgraded S P.J. Locke and LB Marist Liufau from questionable to out for Monday's game.
